## Background
This document covers how to recreate figure 3 from Schaefer et al. (2000) focused on the effect of Hurricane Hugo in Bisley, Puerto Rico. The nutrients in figure 3 contain: (a) potassium, (b) nitrate-N, (c) magnesium, (d) calcium and (e) ammonium-N. The figure 3 includes years 1988 to 1994.

![](../images/figure_3.png)

## Data
```{r}
library(tidyverse)

bq1 <- read_csv("../data/QuebradaCuenca1-Bisley.csv")

bq2 <- read_csv("../data/QuebradaCuenca2-Bisley.csv")

bq3 <- read_csv("../data/QuebradaCuenca3-Bisley.csv")

rio_mameyes <- read_csv("../data/RioMameyesPuenteRoto.csv")
```

## Methods

```{r}
source("../R/moving-average.R")

bq1_moving_avg <- moving_average(bq1, 9)

bq2_moving_avg <- moving_average(bq2, 9)

bq3_moving_avg <- moving_average(bq3, 9)

```
